Title: [tune] Errors when using points_to_evaluate argument for a few search algos

Search Space Setup:

```
config={'seed': 0, 'train_start_date': 'None', 'valid_start_date': '2017-01-01', 'test_start_date': '2018-01-01',
	'data_path': 'path/to/data', 'num_epoch': 100, 'loss_fn': loss_fn, 'device': 'cuda:0', 
	'sequence': tune.choice(int_sequence),
	'local_context_len': tune.choice(int_local_context_len), 'batch_size': tune.choice(even_int_batch_size), 'num_heads': tune.choice(int_num_heads),
	'model_dim': tune.choice(even_int_model_dim), 'num_layers': tune.choice([1, 2]), 'dropout': tune.uniform(0, 0.7),

		 'num_heads': 6, 'model_dim': 12, 'num_layers': 1, 'dropout': 0.01, 'stochasticity': False}]
```

`algo = HyperOptSearch(points_to_evaluate=current_best)`
